title: よだかの星 (Yodaka no Hoshi — The Nighthawk Star) — 宮沢賢治
description: よだか (the nighthawk) is the ugliest bird — mottled, wide-mouthed, stumbling on the ground. Mocked by all, bullied by the hawk who demands he change his name to 市蔵 (Ichizō), よだか resolves to leave the world entirely. He says farewell to his brother the kingfisher, flies toward the sun, then the stars — each rebuffs him — until at last he burns up into a cold blue flame and becomes a star. First published posthumously. (~5,800 characters)
